crownPassive.name: The Round Table
crownPassive.text: From round 3 until nightfall, tale and realm no longer matter for your bonds: each of your heroes counts as being from every tale and realm. In rounds 1 and 2 and from nightfall, only normal bonds work. Aspects still count, so a bond needing a Gothic Beast is met by any Beast. This works for penalties as well as bonuses.

actions.name: Attack
actions.text: Standard attack: damage equal to Attack.
